facts.fact: China Eximbank and the Government of Niger signed an RMB 623.7 million concessional loan on 2 January 2014 for the National Backbone Fiber Optic Cable Network, contractor China International Telecommunication Construction Corporation; construction began 15 June 2015 (AidData).
facts.system: National Backbone Fiber Optic Cable Network and Communication Service Project

facts.fact: AidData says over 2,275 km of fibre was installed on three sections (Niamey-Tillabery, Zinder-Diffa, Agadez-Tahoua), 95% complete in November 2016, construction ended Q1 2017 and the project was completed and handed over to local authorities.
